title: Score selector includes both interval endpoints
description: Scores at two and four are selected by 2..4; an exterior score is preserved as an excluded control.

steps.command: execute if entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,tag=lower,tag=selected] if entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,tag=upper,tag=selected] if entity @e[type=minecraft:marker,tag=pp,x=-32,y=48,z=-32,dx=64,dy=48,dz=64,tag=outside,tag=!selected]

notes: Vanilla 26.3 reference expectations are checked live; raw responses remain in campaign artifacts. Simulation is frozen and restored in cleanup. Positive state probes fail on empty or rejected output. Current-source console validation is separate from RCON support. No client or elapsed-tick claim.
